title: Aslan
description: Another vanilla+ minecraft modpack for friends and family!
body:
![aslan](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8f866612524ca482f6f12cebd919de3574a7e35.png)

### Why
Because the world needs another vanilla+ minecraft modpack!

### Goal
The end goal of this modpack is to not exist when minecrafts performance issues are fixed and it's missing QoL features are added.

It's partially built upon the benchmarks, findings and modlist of Simply Optimized 

[![sop](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8b7d5907e8869abcf4b471d13a7b090a8b5120d_0.webp)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop)

It aims to stick to vanilla minecraft with minimal to none new items/blocks/entities added. The idea here is to not lock-in worlds generated with this modpack.

### Modification
Feel free to modify and redistribute this modpack as you see fit.

### Versioning
Versioning follows [semver](https://semver.org/).
